items.description: Flex Mail is a web application that provides address hygiene (CASS, NCOA, De-duplication) and postal sorting for bulk mailing through the USPS as a seamless embedded function. This application uses the TEC Mailing API.

The service provides data verification and email preparation, validating address list entries and formats. It cleans mailing list entries to optimize successful deliveries for promotional campaigns, hosted customer-relationship management (CRM) communications, and direct mail deliveries.API methods support submission of mailing lists of recipient addresses and related information. Methods return deduped lists, purged of improperly formatted addresses, and corrected for the most effective possible delivery results.
Waterloo Student Housing to help college and university students find rental housing and sublets. Combines UW housing database with Google Maps.

Instant Camera is a web-based application that applies a randomly selected Polaroid filter to your images. Images can be taken from your webcam or uploaded from your desktop and shared instantly on Facebook and Twitter.
DoDyDO is a social networking mashup that focuses on content sharing. You can post text, photos, maps, links, and more. The idea is that you can follow people and topics.
Western Pennsylvania high school football map that shows schools in the WPIAL. Will eventually have basketball, wrestling, and hockey.
A showcase of the best travel attractions around the world with videos, maps, descriptions, recent blog posts and pictures for almost every attraction.
Lagunagram pulls photos from Instagram and displays posts from in and around downtown Laguna Beach in real-time.

CrimeScore is a service from Your Mapper, an online news organization dedicated to delivering geographic-based information. CrimeScore is a rating based on address-level crime report data. CrimeScore assigns a 1-100 grade to any given location.The CrimeScore API delivers a CrimeScore rating for a given location. Developers simply pass a latitude and longitude, and the API responds with either JSON or CSV formatted data.

A tour and attractions company that has integrated the Rezgo XML API for bookings. The product display and availability pages use the API to pull live updated product data and availability for specific tours and activities.
Allows you to create mosaics of photos from Flickr. Each mosaic is one large image composed of small tile images.
An interactive map to find and add ping pong tables worldwide. For the animation, jQuery was used. The app is optimized for iPhone/iPod Touch as well.
Browse the latest, most popular, and most highly-rated windsurfing videos from YouTube. Eliminates the hassle of searching through YouTube for good windsurfing videos.
Real-time HTML/CSS/Javascript editor and advanced Search Engine dedicated to web development and design.

Home appliances and garden decor stuff products that recommended by Amazon. The Product always up to dated every minutes so no junk products found. Use Amazon API with remote shopping cart like own shop.
From their site: Online contact manager and simple CRM. Keep track of who your business talks to, what was said, and what to do next.
Ramazon uses the Flare Visualization Toolkit to create an interactive visualization of related items on Amazon.com.

A generative artwork that explores how advertising uses and manipulates language. Real corporate slogans are remixed and randomized to generate invented slogans, then paired with Flickr images, generating fake advertisements on the fly.

Emergency response team management and analytics software. Performs automatic analysis of incidents to look for patterns and trends in response times, injuries encountered and casualty demographics. Features include hotspot cluster mapping to identify areas at higher risk.
Identify pills using your phone or IM client. Pillbox will ask you a series of questions about your pill to help you identify it.

Posterizer is the best way to show what movies you love. Create a virtual poster wall with posters from you favorite movies. Export your poster wall to an image, and make it your new desktop background or facebook cover!
Upload your GPS tracks stored in GPX format, and see your tracks and your friends tracks in satellite view.
Map of about 250 places to put up a wedding party tent in southeast UK. Combines mapping with real offline research to provide information that is available nowhere else.

This mashup feeds the semantic web service Calais every five minutes with the most recent tweets behind the current twitter trends in order to determine tags for these trends. With the resulting tag set at your fingertips.

Blinksale is a web application that allows professionals and small businesses to send invoices on the Web. Users can create invoices from a template or choose to customize the design. The API allows developers to integrate Blinksale to work with other applications in thier business workflow. The API uses RESTful calls and responses are formatted in XML.

Make a Minyan allows members of a synagogue to be notified when short of the 10 men necessary to pray. Users subscribe to a minyan and can receive notifications via text message, email, or phone call. They can then respond if they are coming and say if they are bringing others.
Route planning mashup for multiple destinations. Finds the fastest route for all locations and sorts waypoints in optimal order.

ArtistData provides secure XML feeds to partners interested in getting information from the artists who use the ArtistData dashboard. The current information available through secure XML feeds is shows, news and blogs.ArtistData is building solutions to automate the updating of artist websites, social network profiles, concert databases, Twitter, official news feeds, iCal, local press, fan newsletters, and even tour books. When an artist updates our site, we update all their sites.

Google and NORAD, the North American Aerospace Defense Command, have partnered to let you track Santa and his travels from the North Pole using Google Maps and Google Earth. The Santa Tracker goes live at 6am EST on December 24th.
Find a business broker visually using Google Maps.
Stockaholic uses the EditGrid dynamic images to mashup charts from Yahoo Finance. See the Instructions tab to see how to do it.
Web mapping based application to watch most viewed videos on YouTube filtered by countries and time.

This is a drawing tool for polyline, polygon , polygon with holes, rectangle, circle, marker(icon), direction(route, path). This application uses the Google Maps API Version 3 (V3). It has all the features of Google Maps MyMaps and has direct access to the code for the shapes (overlays) you create.
A mashup of Blogger and Google Calendar. Embed links and summaries of blog posts in your calendar.
Calls you when you've lost your phone, and lets you record a public message telling everyone where you found it.

www.pinkbigmac.com is a web application developed by Pink Big Mac Media that lets users virtually explore different destinations around the world. Depending on the destination, the web application supplies pictures and information on the historical background, significance, popularity, and more.
Embeddable driving directions widget. Create driving directions for your site, with an animated Street View tour of your route.
A flight planning tool for pilots based on Google Maps. Shows airports near your current location, with colour coding for weather conditions reported in METARs, as well as TFR outlines.
Kent County Council. View road traffic status and live camera feeds in the UK.

The service provides online tools for business organizations to manage travel and expense reporting and reimbursement. Integrated travel booking functions combine with expense reporting within a single platform. The API allows integration with applications of customer companies, partner service providers, or independent third-party developers including mobile app developers.API methods support submission and tracking of travel requests and booking of transportation and lodging, either for individuals or for groups completing the same travel. Methods also support creating, updating, and submitting expense reports as part of a reimbursement process.
Mashup with information on over 100,000 cities, towns, and places around the world.
Streeartmap supports buskers works and gives visitors the possibility to vote every single performance, like digg.
